points.title: 少年求学
points.description: 苏轼出生于四川眉山的一个书香门第，父亲苏洵是著名文学家。少年时期，苏轼与弟弟苏辙一起在家乡接受教育，展现出卓越的文学天赋。1056年，苏轼与苏洵、苏辙三人一同赴京参加科举考试，次年苏轼与苏辙同时考中进士，轰动一时。这段时期奠定了苏轼深厚的文化底蕴和开阔的视野，为他日后的文学成就和政治生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Su Shi was born into a scholarly family in Meishan, Sichuan, where his father Su Xun was a renowned writer. During his youth, Su Shi received education at home alongside his younger brother Su Zhe, displaying remarkable literary talent. In 1056, Su Shi, Su Xun, and Su Zhe traveled to the capital to take the imperial examinations. The following year, both Su Shi and Su Zhe passed the highest level of examinations, causing a sensation. This period established Su Shi's profound cultural foundation and broad perspective, laying the groundwork for his future literary achievements and political career.

points.title: 初入仕途
points.description: 考中进士后，苏轼被任命为大理评事、签书凤翔府判官等职，开始了他的仕途生涯。在开封期间，他积极参与政治活动，与欧阳修等文坛领袖交往密切，形成了自己的文学风格。这一时期，苏轼创作了大量诗文，如《刑赏忠厚之至论》等，展现了他深厚的文学功底和独立思考能力。同时，他开始关注民生疾苦，形成了自己独特的政治理念，为后来的改革思想奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After passing the examinations, Su Shi was appointed as an official in positions such as Da Li Ping Shi and Qian Shu Feng Fu Pan Guan, beginning his official career. During his time in Kaifeng, he actively participated in political activities and closely interacted with literary leaders like Ouyang Xiu, developing his own literary style. During this period, Su Shi created numerous literary works such as 'On the Ultimate Benevolence of Punishment and Reward,' demonstrating his profound literary foundation and independent thinking abilities. Simultaneously, he began to pay attention to the people's livelihood, forming his unique political philosophy that laid the foundation for his later reform ideas.

points.title: 外放杭州
points.description: 因与王安石变法派政见不合，苏轼自请外放，先后在杭州、密州、徐州等地任职。在杭州期间，他主持疏浚西湖，修建苏堤，改善了当地水利条件，至今仍是杭州著名景点。这一时期，苏轼创作了大量描写自然风光和抒发个人情怀的作品，如《饮湖上初晴后雨》等，形成了豪放派词风。同时，他深入民间，了解百姓疾苦，创作了许多反映社会现实的作品，如《荔枝叹》等，体现了他忧国忧民的情怀。
points.descriptionEn: Due to political disagreements with Wang Anshi's reform faction, Su Shi requested to be assigned to local posts, serving in places like Hangzhou, Mizhou, and Xuzhou. During his time in Hangzhou, he supervised the dredging of West Lake and built the Su Causeway, improving the local water conservancy conditions, which remains a famous scenic spot today. During this period, Su Shi created numerous works describing natural scenery and expressing personal emotions, such as 'Drinking on the Lake in Sunny and Rainy Weather,' forming a bold and unrestrained poetic style. Meanwhile, he immersed himself in local communities, understanding the people's hardships, and wrote many works reflecting social realities, such as 'Lament for Lychees,' demonstrating his concern for the nation and its people.

points.title: 乌台诗案
points.description: 1079年，因诗文中含有对新法不满的言论，苏轼被御史台官员弹劾，引发'乌台诗案'，被贬为黄州团练副使。这是苏轼人生的重要转折点。在黄州的五年间，他生活困苦，但创作却进入巅峰期。这一时期，他创作了《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》、《前后赤壁赋》等千古名篇，形成了独特的'东坡'风格。同时，他开始研究佛道思想，形成了旷达的人生态度。黄州的经历使苏轼的思想更加成熟，文学风格更加多元，也为他后来的政治生涯积累了宝贵的经验。
points.descriptionEn: In 1079, due to poems and writings containing expressions of dissatisfaction with the new policies, Su Shi was impeached by officials from the Censorate, leading to the 'Wutai Poetry Case,' and he was demoted to Deputy Commander of the Militia in Huangzhou. This marked a significant turning point in Su Shi's life. During his five years in Huangzhou, although living in hardship, his creativity reached its peak. During this period, he created timeless masterpieces such as 'Nian Nu Jiao: Reflections at Red Cliffs' and 'The Former and Later Rhapsodies on Red Cliffs,' forming a unique 'Dongpo' style. Meanwhile, he began studying Buddhist and Taoist philosophies, developing a broad-minded attitude towards life. The experience in Huangzhou matured Su Shi's thoughts, diversified his literary style, and accumulated valuable experience for his later political career.

points.title: 短暂回朝
points.description: 1084年，宋哲宗即位，司马光重新掌权，苏轼被召回京城，担任翰林学士等职。在朝期间，他反对司马光全盘废除新法的极端做法，提出'参用其长'的折中方案，体现了他的政治智慧。然而，由于他与新旧两党都保持距离，再次受到排挤。这一时期，苏轼创作了《定风波》等作品，表达了他面对政治风波的从容态度。同时，他继续深入研究文学理论，提出了'辞达而已矣'的文学主张，对后世文学发展产生深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1084, Emperor Zhezong ascended the throne, Sima Guang regained power, and Su Shi was recalled to the capital, serving in positions such as Hanlin Scholar. During his time at court, he opposed Sima Guang's extreme approach of completely abolishing the new policies, proposing a moderate solution of 'using the strengths of both sides,' demonstrating his political wisdom. However, due to his maintaining distance from both the old and new factions, he was again marginalized. During this period, Su Shi created works such as 'Ding Feng Bo,' expressing his calm attitude towards political turmoil. Meanwhile, he continued to deeply study literary theory, proposing the literary concept of 'words should only express meaning,' which had a profound impact on the later development of literature.

points.title: 晚年流放
points.description: 1094年，新党重新得势，苏轼被贬至惠州，后又贬至儋州（今海南）。在岭南的艰苦环境中，苏轼依然保持乐观豁达的态度，创作了大量反映岭南风情的作品，如《食荔枝》等。他积极传播中原文化，兴办教育，对当地文化发展做出贡献。1100年，宋徽宗即位，苏轼获赦北归，途中在常州病逝。晚年的流放生活使苏轼的思想更加成熟，文学创作更加丰富多彩，他的'东坡'形象也由此深入人心，成为中国文学史上不可逾越的高峰。
points.descriptionEn: In 1094, when the new faction regained power, Su Shi was demoted to Huizhou, and later to Danzhou (modern-day Hainan). In the harsh environment of the Lingnan region, Su Shi maintained an optimistic and open-minded attitude, creating numerous works reflecting the local customs, such as 'Eating Lychees.' He actively spread the culture of the Central Plains and established educational institutions, contributing to the local cultural development. In 1100, Emperor Huizong ascended the throne, and Su Shi was pardoned and allowed to return north, but he fell ill and died in Changzhou during the journey. The years of exile in his later life matured Su Shi's thoughts even further, making his literary creation more colorful and diverse. His 'Dongpo' image became deeply embedded in people's minds, establishing him as an insurmountable peak in the history of Chinese literature.

supporter.zh: 苏轼是中国文学史上最伟大的文学家之一，其诗词散文成就卓著，开创了豪放派词风，对后世文学产生深远影响。他不仅是杰出的文学家，还是关心民生的政治家，在各地任职期间兴修水利、赈济灾民，展现了卓越的治理才能。苏轼的人格魅力在于他面对逆境时的乐观豁达，无论身处何地，都能随遇而安，将苦难转化为创作的源泉。他的'东坡'精神成为中国文化中坚韧不拔、乐观进取的象征，激励着无数后人。
supporter.en: Su Shi is regarded as one of the greatest literary figures in Chinese history, with remarkable achievements in poetry, ci poetry, and prose. He pioneered the bold and unrestrained style of ci poetry, exerting profound influence on later literature. Not only was he an outstanding writer, but also a politician who cared for the people's welfare. During his official posts in various places, he constructed water conservancy projects and provided disaster relief, demonstrating exceptional administrative abilities. The charm of Su Shi's personality lies in his optimism and open-mindedness when facing adversity. No matter where he was, he could adapt to his circumstances and transform suffering into a source of creativity. His 'Dongpo' spirit has become a symbol of perseverance and optimism in Chinese culture, inspiring countless later generations.

critic.zh: 苏轼的政治生涯充满波折，其政治立场摇摆不定，既反对王安石变法的激进，又反对司马光全盘废除新法的保守，缺乏坚定的政治信念。在乌台诗案中，他的诗文被断章取义，也反映了他政治上的天真。此外，苏轼虽然才华横溢，但有时过于自负，如《上神宗皇帝书》中的一些言论显得傲慢。他的生活作风也被一些批评者认为是奢侈享乐，与儒家节俭理念相悖。这些局限性使苏轼在政治上难以取得持久成就，也影响了他的历史评价。
critic.en: Su Shi's political career was full of ups and downs, with his political stance wavering. He opposed both the radical reforms of Wang Anshi and the conservative approach of Sima Guang in completely abolishing the new policies, lacking firm political convictions. In the Wutai Poetry Case, his poems were taken out of context, reflecting his political naivety. Furthermore, although immensely talented, Su Shi was sometimes overly arrogant, with some statements in his 'Memorial to Emperor Shenzong' appearing arrogant. His lifestyle was also criticized by some as extravagant and享乐, contrary to Confucian principles of frugality. These limitations prevented Su Shi from achieving lasting success in politics and affected his historical evaluation.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，苏轼被视为中国文化的集大成者，其文学成就与人格魅力并重。他的作品融合了儒、释、道三家思想，形成了独特的文化品格。在流行文化中，苏轼已成为'文人'的典型代表，象征着中国文人的理想人格——才华横溢、忧国忧民、乐观豁达。他的生平故事被广泛传播，成为逆境中坚守理想、随遇而安的生活哲学的象征。苏轼的影响超越了文学领域，渗透到中国社会的各个方面，成为中国文化的重要符号，其'东坡'形象已成为中国文化自信与创造力的象征。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Su Shi is regarded as a master of Chinese culture, with equal emphasis on his literary achievements and personal charisma. His works integrated the philosophies of Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism, forming a unique cultural character. In popular culture, Su Shi has become the typical representative of the 'scholar-official,' symbolizing the ideal personality of Chinese literati—immensely talented, concerned about the nation and its people, and optimistic and open-minded. His life story has been widely disseminated, becoming a symbol of life philosophy that maintains ideals in adversity and adapts to circumstances. Su Shi's influence extends beyond the literary realm, permeating various aspects of Chinese society, and his 'Dongpo' image has become a symbol of Chinese cultural confidence and creativity.

self.zh: 人生如逆旅，我亦是行人。
self.en: Life is like a journey against the current; I too am a traveler.

others.zh: 苏轼之文，如万斛泉源，不择地皆可出，在平地滔滔汩汩，虽一日千里无难。
others.en: Su Shi's writing is like a spring of ten thousand measures of water, which can flow out anywhere. On level ground, it rushes forth abundantly, covering a thousand miles in a day without difficulty.
